source.body: {"steps":[{"type":"selectOne","var":"lot","sql":"@file:emc_matlot_consume-step.sql","params":["${input.barcode}"]},{"type":"failIfNull","var":"lot","error_code":"LOT_NOT_FOUND","error_message":"Material lot not found by barcode"},{"type":"failIfNotEquals","var":"lot.status","equals":"ON_LINE","error_code":"LOT_NOT_ON_LINE","error_message":"Lot must be ON_LINE to consume"},{"type":"selectOne","var":"resp","sql":"@file:emc_matlot_consume-step.sql","params":["${lot.on_job_order_id}"]},{"type":"failIfNull","var":"resp","error_code":"NO_RUNNING_RESPONSE","error_message":"No running response for the staging job order"},{"type":"exec","sql":"@file:emc_matlot_consume-step.sql","params":["${resp.response_id}","${lot.lot_id}","${lot.definition_id}","${input.quantity}","${lot.base_uom}"]},{"type":"exec","sql":"@file:emc_matlot_consume-step.sql","params":["${input.quantity}","${input.quantity}","${lot.lot_id}"]},{"type":"selectOne","var":"after","sql":"SELECT quantity FROM emc_material_lot WHERE lot_id = ?","params":["${lot.lot_id}"]},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","lotId":"${lot.lot_id}","consumedQty":"${input.quantity}","remainingQty":"${after.quantity}"}}]}
